groups.label: Has a factory
groups.description: Called directly through its own createX function.

groups.label: No factory
groups.description: Smaller pieces the string encoders and decoders are built from. Name one in a marker and recover it with getRTFunction.

groups.label: Internal
groups.description: Plumbing another feature compiles for you. You never name these yourself.

functions.name: classSerializerReg
functions.doc: Carries a class's build-time name so it can be registered without pulling in the whole type graph. Internal to registerClassSerializer.

functions.name: cloneExactShape
functions.doc: Copies a value keeping only the properties the type declares.

functions.name: compactForJson
functions.doc: Builds a value whose objects are positional arrays, so property names never reach the wire.

functions.name: compactFromJson
functions.doc: Rebuilds a keyed object from the positional array the compact encoder wrote.

functions.name: formatTransform
functions.doc: Applies the type's format rules to a value, for example trimming a string or clamping a number.

functions.name: fromBinary
functions.doc: Reads a value back from the binary wire format.

functions.name: hasUnknownKeys
functions.doc: Answers whether a value carries any property the type does not declare.

functions.name: jsonDecoder
functions.doc: Turns a JSON string back into a typed value. The strategy decides whether undeclared properties survive.

functions.name: jsonEncoder
functions.doc: Turns a value into a JSON string. The strategy picks how: build a new value, transform in place, write the string in one pass, or use the compact positional wire.

functions.name: jsonSchema
functions.doc: Returns the JSON Schema document describing the type.

functions.name: parse
functions.doc: Restores a JSON.parse output into the typed shape and checks it in one walk, throwing on a mismatch. Undeclared properties are kept.

functions.name: parseFail
functions.doc: Parse, rejecting any value that carries an undeclared property.

functions.name: parseStrip
functions.doc: Parse, with undeclared properties removed before the value is restored.

functions.name: prepareForJsonClone
functions.doc: Builds a new JSON-safe value from the declared shape, so undeclared properties are dropped.

functions.name: prepareForJsonMutate
functions.doc: Turns a value into a JSON-safe value in place. Nothing is allocated and undeclared properties are kept.

functions.name: restoreFromJson
functions.doc: Turns a JSON-safe value back into the typed shape in place, keeping undeclared properties.

functions.name: restoreFromJsonStrip
functions.doc: Rebuilds the typed shape from a JSON-safe value, so undeclared properties are dropped.

functions.name: stringifyJson
functions.doc: Writes a value straight to a JSON string in one pass, with no intermediate value.

functions.name: stripUnknownKeysWire
functions.doc: Blanks undeclared properties on incoming JSON before it is restored.

functions.name: toBinary
functions.doc: Writes a value to the compact binary wire format.

functions.name: unknownKeyErrors
functions.doc: Returns one error per undeclared property, with the path to each one.

functions.name: validate
functions.doc: Answers whether a value matches the type. The cheapest check, and the one every other validator builds on.

functions.name: validateStrict
functions.doc: Answers whether a value matches the type AND carries no undeclared properties, in a single walk.

functions.name: validationErrors
functions.doc: Returns the list of reasons a value does not match the type, with the path to each one.

functions.name: validationErrorsStrict
functions.doc: Returns the reasons a value does not match, including undeclared properties, in a single walk.
